xi_check.statement: xi(s) = xi(1-s) for all s in C -- Riemann functional equation (theorem); s=1/2 is the fixed point of the involution, identity tautological there
xi_check.coincidence: xi(1/2) and ln zeta(2) agree through 3 significant digits (0.497); differ in the 4th; registered coincidence, no claim
xi_check.euler_product_at_half: DIVERGES (sum_p p^-1/2 = inf by PNT): no prime-gas partition function at T = 2; zeta(1/2) is analytic continuation

exact_identity.statement: prod_p (1+p^-sigma) = zeta(sigma)/zeta(2sigma) -> M_full(sigma) = ln zeta(sigma) - ln zeta(2sigma), sigma > 1 (exact)
exact_identity.residue_statement: M_full(sigma) = -ln(sigma-1) - ln zeta(2) + o(1) as sigma -> 1+ (exact)

normalized_R_exact.K1: CONFIRMED: R never equals 1/2; min R ~ 0.805 > 1/2 -- the prime-gas moment does not single out the critical line (it diverges there)

raw_crossing_kappa.note: raw M crosses 1/2 at sigma_star ~ 1.84 -- not 1/2, not 3/2, not 2; no framework meaning

critical_line_moment.asymptotic: grows without bound like ~2*sqrt(x)/ln(x) (PNT); total over all primes = +inf

verdict: K1 CONFIRMED; xi FE exact (theorem); Euler product diverges at s=1/2; M_full = ln zeta(s) - ln zeta(2s) exact; R in (0.805, 1), never 1/2; all numbers are data/theorem-checks; NO claim of RH; framework axis 3/2 and zeta axis 1/2 are different objects (RH07 stands)
